text:
The Delhi Police on Tuesday clarified that it has no objection to the Congress organising a rally at Ramlila Ground on November 1, from 10 am to 5 pm.
This clarification comes after the Congress on Tuesday reportedly claimed it was denied permission to hold an event where the INDIA bloc parties planned a protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar ahead of their November 1 rally in Delhi.
Also Read | Congress vows to go ahead with curtain-raiser for Nov 1 rally
"With reference to your letter No. Nil dated 05.10.2026, on the subject cited above, I have been directed to inform you that your request regarding booking NOC for booking of Ramlila Ground from 25.10.2026 to 03.11.2026 to organize rally on 01.11.2026 from 10 AM TO 05 PM has been considered and we have no objection for the same from law & order point of view on the below mentioned terms & conditions subject to obtaining prior permission from the land owning authority," the statement read.
Congress leader K C Venugopal, in an X post on Tuesday, claimed the Ashok Hotel initially allowed it permission to host the event but later denied.
He said 21 parties of the INDIA bloc had planned the "public impeachment of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar as a curtain raiser" on October 30 for the November 1 rally at Ramlila Maidan on "vote chori" charge.
"First they destroy the electoral system, and now they are trying all kinds of tricks to silence those who fight to save our democracy," the leader added.
Venugopal added, "Let it be very clear, come what may, we will not rest until Modi-Shah's puppet Gyanesh Kumar is not removed. If they stop us here, we will go to Amit Shah's house, PM Modi's house, and stage a massive dharna there."
"But we will fight to the finish, and until our mission is accomplished," he concluded in the post.
The planned rally is part of protests by the Congress and other opposition parties against CEC Kumar, demanding his resignation over Special Intensive Revision (SIR) and alleged electoral irregularities.
